notes: The manuscript colophon breaks off mid-sentence with royal titles/biruda ('śtīmallabhūupaticaranakamaradhuridhusa...' for śrī-[...]-malla-bhūpati-caraṇa-kamala-dhūli-dhūsarita...). The king's full name is lost or corrupt (the catalogue indicates '… Malla'). A standard Mahāyāna donor dedication formula is present, but lacks a specific personal name.
